description: This file is an entry point script for a Node.js project related to 'openclaw'. It performs runtime environment checks, manages module imports, handles version validation, and orchestrates startup procedures, including build verification and help message display.

methods.name: parseNodeVersion
methods.description: Parses a raw Node.js version string into an object with major and minor components.

methods.name: isSupportedNodeVersion
methods.description: Checks if a Node.js version object meets the minimum required version.

methods.name: ensureSupportedNodeVersion
methods.description: Ensures the running Node.js version is supported; exits with an error message if not.

methods.name: isModuleNotFoundError
methods.description: Determines whether an error is a module not found error.

methods.name: isDirectModuleNotFoundError
methods.description: Checks if an error is a module not found error specifically for a given import specifier.

methods.name: installProcessWarningFilter
methods.description: Attempts to import and install a process warning filter from specified modules.

methods.name: tryImport
methods.description: Attempts to dynamically import a module, returning true if successful, false if module not found.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks asynchronously if a specified module path exists.

methods.name: buildMissingEntryErrorMessage
methods.description: Builds an error message indicating missing build artifacts, suggesting how to build the project.

methods.name: isBareRootHelpInvocation
methods.description: Checks if the command-line invocation requests help output.

methods.name: loadPrecomputedRootHelpText
methods.description: Loads precomputed help text from a JSON file if available.

methods.name: tryOutputBareRootHelp
methods.description: Attempts to output help information if invoked with help flags; uses precomputed or dynamically imported modules.
